name: Witch Doctor: raid/party buffs with a secondary SpellMod clause (#1031, #847, #1775)
contract: #1031 One Armed Waltz (705909, family 19, no class mask of its own) carries three SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) effects targeting the caster: effect0 BasePoints 24->25 op 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2) class-masked to Big Bad Voodoo's self-buff 802718 (flags[0]=0x8000); effect1 BasePoints 24->25 op 23 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT3) same mask; effect2 BasePoints -6->-5 op 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2) class-masked to Big Bad Voodoo's outer cast 802719 (flags[2]=0x2000). 802718's own effect1 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, BasePoints -51->-50) and effect2 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_DONE_PERCENT, BasePoints -51->-50) combine with One Armed Waltz's flat +25 to read -25%, matching the tooltip 'now only reduces damage dealt by 25%'; the healing-done slot mirrors it (same mechanism, not itself quoted by the tooltip). 802719's effect1 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, BasePoints -21->-20) combines with One Armed Waltz's flat -5 to read -25%, matching 'reduces damage taken by an additional 5%'. This is the vanilla generic SpellMod pipeline (Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers, Unit.cpp; SpellInfo::IsAffected matching SpellFamilyName 19 + overlapping SpellFamilyFlags, SpellInfo.cpp) with no module code involved. #847 Dark Loa's Blessing (560545, family 19) has effect0 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID carrying SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (MiscValue 127, all schools) BasePoints 2->3, delivered raid-wide by the vanilla Spell::EffectApplyAreaAura path; effect1 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) op 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION) and effect2 the same aura op 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME), both BasePoints -21->-20 and both class-masked (flags[0]=0x8) to Shadow Puppets (500015, family 19, flags[0]=0x8, EffectAmplitude 750ms both periodic effects): the -20% activation-time mod lands on SpellAuraEffects.cpp's generic per-periodic-effect ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME) call, 750ms -> 600ms, matching 'Shadow Puppets now deals damage 20% faster'. #1775 Strength of Da Loa (300871, family 19) has effect0/1 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID carrying SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER_PCT and SPELL_AURA_MOD_RANGED_ATTACK_POWER_PCT, both BasePoints 4->5, delivered raid-wide the same way; effect2 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER op 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME) BasePoints -51->-50, class-masked (flags[1]=0x2000) to Spirit (561136, family 19, flags[1]=0x2000, EffectAmplitude 4000ms on both its energize and heal periodic effects), landing on the same generic per-periodic-effect path: 4000ms -> 2000ms, i.e. restoration occurs twice as often, matching 'occurs 50% more often'. All three spells, and their target siblings, were read live from Spell.dbc for this scenario (SpellFamilyName/SpellFamilyFlags/EffectBasePoints/EffectApplyAuraName/EffectMiscValue/EffectSpellClassMask/EffectAmplitude); SPELLMOD_EFFECT2=12, SPELLMOD_EFFECT3=23, SPELLMOD_DURATION=1, SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME=19 per src/server/game/Spells/SpellDefines.h. This is a regression scenario: all three clauses are delivered by vanilla core SpellMod/AreaAura code already present without any module change, so it makes no code change and every assertion is expected to pass on the current tree.
